narrative.overview: Orbit looks like the shared lounge of a campus building: warm, soft, a little playful, and easy to walk into between classes. The page is cream. Color comes from the community a thing belongs to, so a post, a filter and a hangout in the same community share one pastel. A single violet, used for the sidebar and a few anchors, keeps the whole thing from drifting into candy.
keyCharacteristics: Cream ground with pastel cards colored by community.
One violet anchor (the icon rail) and a gold highlight for today.
Pill buttons and pill filters; large rounded cards.
Glass is a small accent on hangout cards only.
Light headings, tight tracking, one typeface family (DM Sans).
Every state is shown with more than color.

rules.name: The Pastel-Means-Community Rule
rules.body: A pastel always identifies a community. It is never used as decoration on something that has no community.

rules.name: The One Violet Rule
rules.body: Violet is the single saturated anchor. If a screen needs a second strong color, the design is wrong, not the palette.

rules.name: The Honest Color Rule
rules.body: Color never carries meaning alone. Hangout days use orange, pink and green together with a dashed outline, a struck-through number, and a hover label.

rules.name: The No Page Title Rule
rules.body: App pages open straight into content. Page headings exist for screen readers only, not as large visible titles.

rules.name: The Glass Stays Small Rule
rules.body: Frosted glass appears on hangout cards on Home and the calendar only. Chat cards, post tiles and every other surface stay plain.

rules.name: The Steady Card Rule
rules.body: A card never changes size because of a state change.

dos: Do keep the ground Cream (#fbf7f3) and let pastels carry meaning.
Do make every state change visible without moving other things.
Do use soft Ink (#5f5650) tinted text on pastels, from that pastel's ink.
Do give every deletion an Undo instead of a confirmation dialog.
Do keep rewards optional, quiet and unranked.
Do let motion be exponential ease-out, short, and switched off for reduced motion.
donts: Don't add big page titles, kicker labels, or demo notices to app pages.
Don't use frosted glass on chat cards, post tiles or general panels.
Don't build a phone-style bottom tab bar. This is a website.
Don't let a card resize when its toggle or content changes.
Don't use a second saturated color next to violet.
Don't rely on color alone for status.
Don't use native select lists; use the themed picker.
